lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh Behold the mountain rising high
The rivers carve the earth they sigh Who can measure skies so wide
Or count the stars that nightly glide The hands that shape the galaxies
Hold the breath of you and me, you're sons of men
Come see, come see, the truth that sets the captive free
Word of secret, word of secret, the works of men
They fade, they fall, but love remains
It remains, it conquers all
The sun will set, the earth will spin
The waves will crash, the tides begin
But deep, but still beyond the veil
A love that none can break or fail
The light that split the endless night
Still burns for us, still shines so bright
Oh, sons of man
The truth that sets a captive free
Oh, the works of man
They fade
But love remains
It goes on
Thanks for watching!
